subject: Fix heard-steps noise vs officer CallAlert delivery order (11)
description:
Split out of #19 — this is NOT the same root cause as #19's reach-point half (that was the AI's self_animation being re-read live instead of from the latched mpOrder; fixed in da65a5097).

11 traces, all Savegame_linux3/Profile_001/Savegame_018 (replay-001,002,004,005,006,009,010,012,013 in parity-random-save-replays-60s-15x plus replay-001,002 in parity-random-save-replays). Signature: Soldier(SoldierId(132)).ai.substate original=248 (SeekingHeardstepsPreReactiontime) rust=71 (SeekingHeardstepsReactiontime), first divergence f27759, with detection.view_status original=7 rust=1 alongside.

What the Rust trace shows at f27759 for soldier 132, in order: CallAlert while Default/DefaultGotoRoute -> Seeking/SeekingGroupCalledByOfficer; then CallLookThere; then EventHear while already Seeking; then several more EventHear that are correctly ignored.

The noise handler (original-code/RHartificialmalignity.cpp:8559-8613) branches on the state at the moment the noise arrives: `mCurrentState == STATE_SEEKING && substate != GOT_STOP_EVENT && rank != OFFICER` goes straight to SUBSTATE_SEEKING_HEARDSTEPS_REACTIONTIME with LaunchTimer(1); every other case goes to SUBSTATE_SEEKING_HEARDSTEPS_PRE_REACTIONTIME. The Original lands on PRE_REACTIONTIME, so when its noise arrived the soldier was NOT yet in STATE_SEEKING — i.e. the Original processed the noise BEFORE the officer's CallAlert, and Rust processes it after. This is a delivery-order problem between the noise broadcast and the officer's alert call, not a timer problem (both sides LaunchTimer(1), as the earlier handoff noted).

Useful C++ anchor: RHElementActorNPC::Noise (RHelementactornpc.cpp:4845+) is fully synchronous — it walks every NPC and calls pVillain->Think(EVENT_HEAR) inline at the instant the noise is made, so the noise lands in the slot of whichever element produced it. Next step is to establish which creation slot emits the footstep noise vs which slot issues the officer CallAlert, and whether Rust defers either into a later phase.

Repro: ROBINHOOD_DATA_DIR=datadirs/fullgame_linux target/debug/examples/original_parity_replay --no-auto-dump parity-random-save-replays/traces/Savegame_linux3/Profile_001/Savegame_018/replay-001-session-0001.jsonl.zst (~27k frames, slow in debug). RUST_LOG=robin_engine::ai_enemy=trace gives the think: ENTRY / set_state lines used above.
